complexity.notes: Minor inefficiency: the list ['(', '{', '['] is rebuilt on every iteration; a precomputed set or a dict mapping closers to openers would be more idiomatic. The chained pop-in-condition elifs work due to short-circuiting but are slightly harder to read than a lookup-based match check.
complexity.summary: Classic stack-based validation: push opening brackets, and on each closing bracket pop and verify the matching type, rejecting early on mismatch or empty stack; finally the stack must be empty.
